verdict.rationale: Data-use and training policy is a fair question for a hosted search service that stores customer data and runs managed embedding and reranking models, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used for model training, and no opt-out control. Encryption at rest, customer-managed keys, BAAs and BYOC deployment are adjacent security controls, not a no-training commitment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
